crossRefs.note: Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
They were given power, not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a…

translations.web: They have tails like those of scorpions, and stings. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.
translations.bsb: They had tails with stingers like scorpions, which had the power to injure people for five months.
translations.kjv: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to hurt men five months.
translations.asv: And they have tails like unto scorpions, and stings; and in their tails is their power to hurt men five months.
